items.title: Move Over, Storytellers: The Marketing Engineers Are Here
items.summary: The industry that previously fell in love with job titles like “digital ninja” and “storyteller” is latching onto a new coinage, the WSJ Leadership Institute’s Katie Deighton reports: the marketing engineer.  Greg Bresnitz, who had already been working on automation in the marketing department at the blockchain platform Optimism, was in the audience when a conference keynote speaker started describing the “marketing engineer.”  To others, though, “marketing engineer” is just the latest in the industry’s procession of faddish titles, this time enlisting AI to suggest a level of precision and control that marketers aren’t always credited for.
